title: A Swim Before Work
transcript: The Riverside Pool will open an hour earlier on weekdays from the beginning of June. The manager says many customers requested a chance to swim before work. The main pool will be open from six, but swimming lessons will still start at eight as usual. People who arrive before seven will be able to leave their bicycles in a locked area behind the building. The earlier hours will continue through September if enough people use them.

questions.prompt: What change will the pool make in June?
options: It will open earlier on weekdays.
It will close later at weekends.
It will offer longer swimming lessons.
It will introduce a new entrance.
questions.answer: It will open earlier on weekdays.
questions.explanation: 六月初起，游泳池工作日提早一小时开门。

questions.prompt: What can early visitors do with their bicycles?
options: Bring them inside the main hall.
Leave them in a locked area.
questions.answer: Leave them in a locked area.
questions.explanation: 七点前到达的访客可把自行车存放在楼后带锁区域。
